description: Every active Security Hub control failure (CIS 3.0.0 and FSBP) is remediated or in the exception record, each exception with its reason; the pass rate across evaluated controls is recorded. Disabled controls are recorded in securityhub_controls.tf

exceptions.reason: Session keys (database until 2026-10-02, secrets, logs) are scheduled for deletion at every teardown by design: they encrypt what the teardown destroys. The persistent keys are carved out, so one of them scheduled for deletion fails.
